$comment: The canonical list of workspace packages KinetixUI publishes to npm. This file is the only
thing that grants publication permission — a package is never published because it merely
lacks `private: true`.
Every other workspace package must carry `private: true`. A package that is neither listed
here nor private fails `pnpm release:check` before anything is built or published, which is
the check that would have caught @kinetixui/angular before the 0.23.0 partial release.
RELEASE GROUPS. A group is a release cohort: the packages in it go out together. Membership is
explicit, never inferred from a name, a directory, a version or Changesets config. `core` is
the React set, which releases in lockstep — `sameVersion` makes that a rule the planner
enforces rather than a convention. `angular` is a Preview package on its own lifecycle, so it
carries its own version and its own release commit. `iot` is a new experimental module that
depends on no other workspace package, so nothing versions with it either. A release in one
group never publishes, tags or re-tags anything in another.
`build` names scripts in the root package.json, run in order before packing. `requireFiles`
are paths that must exist inside the packed tarball, on top of every target declared by the
package's own `main` / `module` / `types` / `exports` / `bin` fields, which are checked
automatically.
`artifactDirectory` is for a package whose publishable artifact is not its workspace root.
@kinetixui/angular is built by ng-packagr, which generates the Angular Package Format manifest
into `dist/` — that is the package npm receives, while `directory` stays the workspace identity
the allowlist is matched against. See RELEASING.md.
